sections.decision: Keep the printed correction date and explicit supersedure field; the diagonal SUPERSEDED watermark on every rendered page establishes lifecycle=superseded, but no successor or distinct correction target is inferred.
Use the source dates, manufacturer, TCDS and type designations; remove the ATA prefix from the normalized subject and normalize ATA 28 title to Fuel.
Retain B's eight action-specific groups; correct the solution-A extension to the five printed A330 models plus A340-200/-300, preserving production/service exclusions and ACT conditions.
No formal definition clause is present; keep an empty array.
Preserve the TWA800/SFAR-88 context and the stated chafing, bonding, separation and missing-lead hazards without creating an unstated accident-causation claim.

Use nine atomic requirements, including inspection plus conditional corrective action, action-specific modifications, the solution-A whichever-first maintenance opportunity, and an ongoing spare-ACT limitation without inventing a records-review duty.
Treat 'Unless already accomplished' as a blanket exception for the one-time/actionable measures, not as previous-action credit and not as an exception to the future spare-ACT limitation.
Keep only the three explicit revision-specific credits for Actions 2, 3 and 5; remove B's global unless-accomplished item because it is an exception.
Retain B's 25 revision/role-specific references and add the two earlier-issue SB references that trigger Action 2 additional work; no missing dates are looked up.
Keep explicit candidate supersedes and retains-requirements-of edges to AD 2006-0322; leave targets unresolved and manually_verified=false, and create no correction/successor edge.
Retain the exact EASA 'can accept' AMOC wording and the printed regulatory and Airbus technical contacts.
Classify A330/A340, ATA 28, mixed frequency and mixed compliance; derive action types from the resolved requirements and keep human_confirmed=false.

overall_rationale: Source-grounded third-machine reconciliation of frozen A/B submissions; the candidate remains unreviewed and must be independently confirmed by a human before it can enter the gold set.
